channel.title: Madagascar - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Madagascar, every source cited.

item.title: Madagascar signs Russian accords on health, education, mining
item.description: Colonel Michaël Randrianirina announced agreements for mobile medical labs and increased student scholarships following a summit in Russia.

item.title: Fanjiry association launches in Avaradrano
item.description: The wife of the President of the Republic officially established the association on October 31.

item.title: Émile Ratefinanahary re-elected head of Madagascar karate federation
item.description: Ratefinanahary secured 11 votes for his second term after an election attended by 12 of 15 regional leagues.

item.title: Madagascar tennis and volleyball figure Ravalitera Rafolomanantsiatosika dies
item.description: Ravalitera Rafolomanantsiatosika, known as Ravaly, trained generations of tennis players and coaches.
